identity.title: Effects of electroacupuncture combined with flurbiprofen axetil on postoperative pain and early functional recovery after breast cancer surgery
identity.notes: First page labels Case Control Study, footnote STROBE; methods describe prospective computer block randomized trial. Accept randomized description provisionally; clarify editorial/design inconsistency.

design.comparator: Superficial nonacupoint needling with inactive stimulator; both receive flurbiprofen axetil
design.population: Adults18-75 breast surgery, IV general anesthesia; Feb2019-Jan2020
design.intervention: ST36/SP6 needles,2/10Hz per methods,30min preinduction through end; discussion2/100Hz conflicting

regimen.rescue: Morphine1-3mg IV or paracetamol1000mg IV according to VAS; FA50mg at suturing; tropisetron4.48mg IV
regimen.location: p3; p7 explicitly rescue opioid not recorded

results.location: p3 threshold; p5 Table2 moderate/severe subcounts30/2,24/1,16/0 vs41/1,29/0,19/0

source_conflicts: VAS mean/SD pairs incompatible with numbersVAS>4, e.g. EA24h movement32/65>4 but mean2.862 SD0.233. Preserve print; no SEM assumption or correction.
Surgery counts Table1 total70 controls and60 EA despite65 each; percentages use130.
Editorial Case Control/STROBE vs randomized methods. No registration/SAP identified in full paper or official article page.
independence: Distinct from He hepatectomy article by first-page identity, operation and setting; no linked cohort identified.

1.1: Computer random length blocks explicitly described
1.2: Randomization investigator independent of anesthesia/recording, but concealment before enrollment unspecified
1.3: Surgery categories sum70/60 versus claimed65/65; baseline allocation table cannot be reconciled
2.1: Sensation-driven EA versus superficial inactive sham; authors acknowledge detectable differences
2.3: Uniform anesthesia and rescue protocol; no documented trial-context departures
2.6: 130 included in statistics,65 each; no reported exclusions
3.1: All130 reportedly analyzed; no attrition indicated
4.1: VAS appropriate; internal reporting inconsistency handled separately from instrument validity

5.1: No registration or prospectively finalized SAP in publication/official page
5.2: Multiple pain measures/times without prospective specification
5.3: No dated analysis plan and dispersion label inconsistent

rob_independent.reason: Multiple unresolved concerns in design/allocation reporting, subjective assessment and prospective analysis substantially lower confidence; continuous pain additionally held for internally impossible printed SDs.
